ISSUE_KIND: pothole
ISSUE: Pothole filled with water in the road surface
DETAILS: The photo shows a large pothole filled with rainwater in the asphalt roadway, surrounded by cracked pavement.
ORGANIZATION: Maryland Department of Transportation State Highway Administration
DEPARTMENT: District 3 (Laurel Maintenance Facility)
WHY: Baltimore Avenue at this location is U.S. Route 1, a state highway under the jurisdiction and maintenance of the Maryland State Highway Administration (District 3) rather than the City of College Park. The City of College Park explicitly directs issues on Baltimore Avenue/Route 1 to the State Highway Administration.
COVERAGE_QUOTE: "Streets that are owned or maintained by MDOT SHA (Maryland Department of Transportation State Highways. Administration) or DPW&T (Prince George's County Department of Public Works and Transportation) are excluded from this study. Examples of state roads within city limits include MD 193 (University Boulevard/. Greenbelt Road) and US 1 (Baltimore Avenue)."
